paite: Ka tapa, ka thute na san a, ka thupiakte nang a na kholkhawmleh;
heading: Pilna Kipahmante
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

paite: huchi a pilna lam a na bil na doh a, theihsiamna lam a na lung na suk leh;
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

paite: ahi, theihkakna na sap a, theihsiamna ding a na aw na suahleh;
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

paite: dangka bang a huai na zon a, gou sel bang a huai na zonleh;
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

paite: huchi in TOUPA kihtakna na theisiam ding a, Pathian theihna na mu ding hi.
english: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

paite: TOUPA'N lah pilna ape ngal a; akam a kipan in theihna leh theihsiamna ahong pai hi.
english: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

paite: Midik a ding in pilna hoih akholkhawm a, muanhuaina a omte amaute a ding in lum ahi.
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

paite: Vaihawmna lampite aventheihna ding in, amisiangthoute lampi ahawitheihna ding in.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

paite: Huchi in diktatna leh vaihawmna na theisiam ding a, huan, hawmsiamna, ahi, lampi hoih chiteng.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

paite: Na lungtang sung ah pilna ahong lut ding a, huan na kha a ding in theihna anuam ding hi.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

paite: Ngentelna in nang ahon veng ding a, theihsiamna in nang ahon kem ding hi.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

paite: Gilou lampi a kipan ahon hunkhe ding, mi thil hoih lou gente a kipan;
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

paite: lampi tangte mangngilh, khomial lampite a pai ding;
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

paite: gilou hih ding a kipak a, gilou hoihlouhna a nuamsa;
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

paite: alampite ua kawi a, alampite ua dikloute.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

paite: Numei lamdang a kipan nang hon hun ding, mikhualnu athute toh amaitangphatnu a kipan mahmah in;
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

paite: ama'n atuailai lawm anusia a, a Pathian thukhun amangngilh hi.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

paite: A-inn in sihna lampi adoh a, alampite'n misite lampi;
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

paite: amah kiang a hoh kuamah akik nawn kei ua, kuamah in hinna lampite aphazou sam kei uhi.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

paite: Mihoihte lampi a na pai theih a, midiktatte lampi na zuihtheihna ding in.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

paite: Mitangte gamsung a teng ding ahi ua, huan asung ah mihoihkimte a-om tawntung ding uh.
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

paite: Himahleh giloute gam a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua, huan lepchiahtak a hihte huai a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om ding uh.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
